o1: Predicted to enable molecular adaptor activity. Involved in Ras protein signal transduction; meiotic cell cycle; cell division; and regulation of egg-laying behavior. Is located in the cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane; cytoplasmic vesicle; and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Is expressed in embryo; germ line; gonad arm; nervous system; pharynx; and tail. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including breast cancer (multiple); intrinsic cardiomyopathy (multiple); lipodystrophy (multiple); muscle tissue disease (multiple); and systemic scleroderma (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including CAV1 (caveolin 1).
